propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE tells FAIL callers that adding ticket-comment evidence will be reconsidered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external criteria
ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md deliberately classify untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable, rejecting ticket-only external evidence by contract
An operator followed incomplete guidance, added concrete evidence in a ticket comment without the required tag, and received a second FAIL because the criterion remained untagged and unadmissible
The remediation wording must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact tag prerequisite

The strengthened interface test requires the canonical codebase-verifiable kind, the exact [operator-attested] tag, and the statement that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone
